description: This file is a C++ source file implementing lazy-loading wrappers for CUDA linear algebra functions within the ATen library of PyTorch. It manages dynamic library loading, dispatching, and stub functions for various linear algebra routines specifically for CUDA backend, with conditional compilation and namespace encapsulation.
